author: Employedchud
quote: Solid gameplay but sloppy story. I had fun! I do wish they made Logan a bit less wimpy but I knew I was getting into a movie game with too many cutscenes so 8/10 for what it was.

author: Employedchud
quote: As an employed, married man at 26 years old, I want to come home and relax with escapism. This game forces realism chores, digital girlfriend lectures, and highly restricted actions as "free will options". This is disappointing. I wish Sony offered refunds, but Rockstar didn't release it on Steam initially for that reason; I want to believe. Cannot believe this is our timeline, our current Rockstar, and our GTA VI. What a crash and burn. I have fully uninstalled and went back comfortably to Spacemarine 2, Darktide, and Cyberpunk 2077. At least I get 120 Hz, and the games are beautiful.
